label: Guide me: Agents

params.name: lede
params.default: Helpers in {product} that do routine work for you - shown first, done when you say so.
params.label: The cover's opening line; {product} = this edition's name

params.name: icon
params.label: The emblem on the cover (an icon name)

params.name: steps

default.title: Helpers that work for you
default.say: Agents do routine work in {product} - such as checking that everything the portal needs is working. Each card is one agent.

default.title: What it does, step by step
default.say: Under each agent you see its steps in order. A grey tag only looks; an amber tag changes something; a green Trusted tag means that step may run without asking when the agent works on its own.

default.title: Dry run first
default.say: Press Dry run to see exactly what the agent would do. Nothing is changed - its findings appear on the card, and anything it would change is marked Would do.

default.title: Approve
default.say: When a dry run would change something, Approve appears. Press it and the agent does what the dry run showed, for real.

default.title: Runs by itself
default.say: Tick Runs by itself to let an agent work on its schedule, or when its event happens. The Daily health check looks at what {product} needs - disk space first - every morning, and keeps one warning bar up to date for the owner: a fixed problem clears it, nothing piles up.

default.title: History
default.say: History lists every run - when, whether you or the agent started it, and what each step found.

params.label: The steps in order: title, say (the narration), target (where the spotlight goes; alternatives split by |, the first on screen wins), art (the picture: hero/flow/roads/meter/stack/check), place (below/above/right/left/center, optional), open (optional: what the guide presses first when the part is not on screen - open the first item, go back Home; alternatives split by |)
